## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or spec
section and note any compatibility, privacy or platform impact.

## Validation

List each command run and its result, including OS and build features where
relevant. State which checks were not run and why. For documentation changes,
check relative links, referenced paths and CLI examples against current source.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, confidential code, local caches or private artifacts are included.
- [ ] I have read the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Report vulnerabilities privately using [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
